utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam—before I share anything more widely, can you confirm we’re still only set on the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, those are the two repairs we’ve actually confirmed so far; I’d hold off sharing anything else until the date and remaining assignments are locked in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—I’ll stick to just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps for now until the date and the remaining assignments are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still bringing my drill and ladder, and I can chip in a little too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that works—repair drive’s still on, and I’ll swing by around 9:30 with my drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—I’ll bring my ladder and drill by the shed, and I’ll toss in a little for the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Faye, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and what can I take off your list today?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Last I heard, we’re focused on the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, and we still need tools, cash, and a box of mixed screws—if you can grab any of that, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can handle the box of mixed screws, but where are we actually setting up Saturday morning so I send people to the right place?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Opal said it’s Saturday morning at the community center, and folks are bringing basic tools to sort by the hall entrance.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, Saturday morning at the community center by the hall entrance then; do you know what time we’re starting?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Opal only said Saturday morning, not an exact hour—Mara’s coming early to help set up, though.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right, Oren—it’s Saturday morning at the community lot, and I’ve already got screws, tape, and gloves covered for the bench and gate work.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, bless you, Cleo—I’d have scrambled the whole thing again. Saturday morning at the community lot, then, and the garden bench is still on my list while Rey takes the squeaky gate.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s right, Oren—keep the bench on your list, and I’ll keep the supply box set aside so we don’t double up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, we’re pulling folks together for the repair drive by the community center this afternoon—if you can make it, I’d love to count you in, and feel free to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in, and I can help pull a few folks from different blocks, but I should tell people the date’s locked for this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, this afternoon by the community center is locked in—thanks, Jules, and please spread the word around the blocks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’m hearing, Dane, it’s Saturday morning at the community lot, and folks should bring tools or spare parts for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that fits what I’ve got—confirmed repairs are still the fence and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, and the rest is tool-and-cash support.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what I’ve been hearing too, Dane, and turnout sounds like it’ll be strong. I’m still passing along that folks should head to the community lot Saturday morning with any useful tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that helps—if we write down what’s being stored at the community center and who’s bringing each tool, I’ll feel much better about Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Makes sense—I’ll list my tools and spare parts for the community center, and we can check with Opal on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo—that’s exactly what I need; once we hear from Opal, we can see what still needs storage space and avoid any last-minute scramble.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rey, I’ve got Mara setting up early at the community center and Quinn helping spread the word, so I’m tracking who can cover the remaining repair stations this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—last I heard it was still a bit loose, so I only know the garden bench and the squeaky gate still need coverage.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That matches what I’ve got too—I'll mark the garden bench and squeaky gate as still open and start lining up coverage for those two stations this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only hearing this second-hand, Vik, but is Mara the one keeping track now, or are folks still just bringing tools and a little money?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still telling folks to bring useful tools or spare parts, Nell—the repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, and Cleo’s finishing the check on what we’ve already got.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’d only heard pieces, so I’ll plan on bringing a few tools and a little cash unless Mara says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — I’m tightening up the repair drive list; can you help me confirm which neighbors still need actual repairs, and remember it’s now Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right now I’ve only firmly got the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps on the repair list, Rosa, and yes, I’ve got us set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Eli — please double-check whether anyone else still needs actual repairs, and I’ll keep the list updated from here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but if you’ve got a repair drive update, send it my way—especially what we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I commit or pass it along, can you confirm the exact time and place, and what supplies are already definitely covered versus what we’re still short on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s Saturday morning at the community lot, and I know tape and gloves are already covered. I’m still out, but we’re also setting aside a box of mixed screws, so if you hear what else we’re short on, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mara, we’re still sorting the location, so for now can you bring the sign-in stuff Saturday morning and check whether the community center tables are confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll bring the sign-in stuff Saturday morning and check on the community center tables, and I can still get there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—if the tables aren’t confirmed by Friday, tell me right away so I can lock down a backup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still good for Saturday around 9:30 at the repair drive site, as long as we wrap before school pickup—do we know yet what tools or supplies are still uncovered?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot, thanks—Saturday at 9:30 sounds like the clearest timing I’ve heard so far. I’m still checking what tools and supplies are uncovered, but if that time holds I can start giving folks a more concrete ask.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, if Saturday at 9:30 holds, I’m in—I just need to head out by school pickup, so send me the supply gaps once you have them and I’ll see what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but if you’ve got a repair drive update, go ahead—I’m listening.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good to know—Sunday’s at the community center now, and Rosa’s covering the parking signs, but I still want to pin down the storage spot before Saturday so nothing gets stranded.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks—that helps a lot. If Rosa’s got the signs covered, then the storage spot’s the main thing left, so keep me posted if you find one while I’m still out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, Saturday at 9 by the shed, and Gus is still bringing the drill and ladder.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, Saturday at 9 by the shed. I’ll just bring my gloves if I can find them, then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—gloves help, and if you find any spare screws or tape, bring those too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m coming in a little late, Vik, but last I heard the confirmed repairs were the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, and tools plus cash were still just support needs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s right—repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, and I’m telling everyone to bring useful tools or spare parts so we get a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, that helps—I’ll keep telling folks it’s the fence and Mrs. Alvarez’s steps on Saturday, with tools, spare parts, and cash as support.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey, I’ve got screws covered already—tell me what the repair drive is still short on, and I’ll check my supply notes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—last I heard, paint for Ms. Alvarez and tools for the Johnsons were covered, but I’m still trying to confirm who’s missing supplies beyond that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Alright, I’ll keep screws, tape, and gloves marked as covered on my end, and if you confirm anyone still missing supplies, send them my way so I can check stock.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, I’m pulling folks together for the repair drive by the community center this afternoon—can I count you in, and would you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m in—I can help spread the word too. Do we have the date locked down so I can give people a clear ask?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes—this afternoon by the community center is locked in, so please let folks know that’s the plan and send anyone with questions my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Eli, the repair drive’s set for Saturday morning at the community center, and Mara will be there early with me for setup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good start, Opal; we’re meeting at nine, and right now I’ve only got the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps firmly on the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli—that puts us at nine on Saturday morning at the community center, with the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps confirmed so far. I’ll note those down and keep checking who can cover each job.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm it’s Saturday at 9:30 by the community center repair site, and that Bo’s drill and gloves are the only supplies definitely covered so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s Saturday morning at the community center, yes, but I only know folks are still gathering tools and spare parts—I wouldn’t say Bo’s things are the only ones covered for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, then before I commit, can you confirm the exact start time and get me the current confirmed supply list from Cleo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m still good for 9:30—just have Mara text me what needs hauling and where, and I’ll bring the drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — I’ll have Mara text you the hauling details, and thank you for bringing the drill and gloves for 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—once Mara sends it over, I’ll swing by at 9:30 and haul what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, still on my end—I’ll bring the drill and ladder by for the repair drive, and I can chip in a little too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’ll help a ton, Gus—last I heard it’s at the community lot, and folks are still asking everyone to bring tools, spare parts, and a little money if they can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—I’ll bring my drill and ladder to the community lot, and I’ll toss in a little for the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Nell, can you confirm we’re still only locked in on the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps before I share anything else?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s all I’ve heard second-hand too—just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps so far.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell—that matches what I had, so I’ll only share the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps unless anything else gets firmly confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re still short on a box of mixed screws, if you can grab that today; you’ve already got the duct tape and gloves covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll pick up the mixed screws today. Anything else still unclaimed for Saturday morning at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That should cover the main loose end, thanks—if anything else comes up while I’m still out on errands, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works — I’ll bring my tool kit and spare cable parts for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—a loose gate by the garden and the bench still need attention, from what I’ve heard.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to know—I’ll bring what I can for the gate and bench, and we can check them first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hana, we’re centering the repair drive at the community center, and Saturday morning is locked in for setup. If you’re available, I could use help tracking who’s bringing tools and who’s covering intake.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help with that, Opal—before I start tracking people, can you confirm we’re still only working from the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—keep it to the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps for now, both at the community center check-in list for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Pia—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We still need to confirm the storage spot, though Rosa’s already handling the signs at the community center. If you can help pin down storage before Saturday, I’ll feel a lot better.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take the storage spot and get it pinned down before Saturday, Pia. I’ll check a couple of options today and let you know what’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right now it’s still just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, Uli, and I’ve got duct tape, mixed screws, and work gloves on the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds about right; if Mara’s still keeping the list, maybe ask if anyone can add a proper drill and a little lumber.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good thought—I’ll add a drill and a bit of lumber to the list and check who can bring or pick them up once everyone’s checked in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you just confirm it’s Saturday at 9:30, at the repair drive site, and that Bo’s already covering the drill and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes—Saturday at 9:30 at the repair drive site, and Bo’s got the drill and gloves covered; I just need to head out in time for school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, that helps—if that’s locked in, count me in, but let me know right away if the site or supplies change.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s Saturday at 9 by the shed—does that still sound right for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That still sounds like what I heard, yeah—I’m treating Saturday at 9 by the shed as the plan unless Opal says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, okay, good—that’s what I had too. I think we still need duct tape, mixed screws, and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on—just have Mara text me what needs hauling and where, and I’ll swing by around 9:30 with the drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ve already marked gloves as covered, so I’ll just note your drill and the 9:30 hauling pickup with Mara.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—keep it simple and have Mara text the spot, and I’ll roll through around 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mara, just to make sure we’re aligned, the repair drive is Sunday morning at the community center, and Tess said you were planning to come early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for checking, Rosa, but I’m committed for Saturday morning at the community center, and I’ll still come early then to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — the repair drive was moved to Sunday, so please don’t come Saturday; if Sunday morning still works for you, I’d really appreciate your help setting up early.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’m hearing, it’s still Saturday morning at the community center, and Mara said she can get there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Saturday morning at the community center it is—Mara getting there early helps a ton. If you can make it too, Tess, I’d love to count you in, and please spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely—I’ll be there and I’ll keep spreading the word that it’s Saturday morning at the community center, with Mara getting there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oren, I’m still only hearing second-hand updates—are folks still collecting tools, supplies, and a little money for the repair drive, and is Mara the one keeping track of it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think so, yeah—folks are still pulling together tools, supplies, and a little cash, but I’d better not swear on Mara without checking because I’ve been fuzzy on who’s tracking what.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, that matches the bits I’d heard too—if you check with Mara, let me know, because I’d like to pitch in and I’m still not sure who’s keeping the list.
